question: What is the dense knot of māyā in I-know?
premises: Here is the very dense knot of māyā, good sirs, neither own nor other, one undivided.
I-know is but the manifestation of a pot-particular.
Manifold variegated arisings shine in the supreme, thus told.
inference: I-knowledge is a pot-particular arising, and the knot is taking own-other as divided.
uncertainties: Paramahasi segmentation unclear with supreme-joy presumed.
plain_english: 'Ah! Here, good sirs, is the very dense knot of māyā. This we declare: here there is neither own nor other, one undivided. 'I know' — that is but the manifestation of a pot-particular; manifold variegated forth-arisings shine in the supreme, thus it is told.
